description: Call this tool to search every cell of a spreadsheet or CSV for text; built-in file readers cannot parse spreadsheets. Matching is case insensitive. Returns cell addresses with a preview of the row each hit is on.

path.description: Path to the .xlsx/.xlsm/.xlsb/.ods/.csv/.tsv file (~ is expanded)

sheet.description: Sheet name; default searches every sheet

text.description: Text to look for; matched case insensitively anywhere inside a cell. Up to 200 hits are returned

name: sheet_find
title: Find text
